Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 145. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 45 ki
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Instant Galick gun
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 120 feet
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: beam
The user fires a purple beam from each hand. You
can hurl them at one target or several.
Roll 2 Beam Attack Rolls dealing 6d6 ki damage on a
successful hit.
